results.title: Defect number of the kernel
results.note: Item 1 (n^{-1/3}s_n -> a finite, Poisson law) is exactly existing 2107; proof 946-972 is the reused range. Item 2 (n^{-1/3}s_n -> infinity, line 252-255) is proved at 974-1000 from the same exact enumeration (Lemma at 478), the same contraction ratios (Lemmas at 780 and 855) and the crude bound (eq:crude1, 733-735). The added calculation is a product bound; line 1000 leaves negative deviations to the reader. Under the instruction not to re-count enumeration/contraction/tail helpers and not to treat a regime switch as a new core, no separate candidate is proposed for item 2.

results.title: Sparse enumeration asymptotics for plane and unicellular maps
results.note: Proof 1007-1034 inverts the zero-defect Poisson probability using counter_index 9 and the classical trivalent formulas (eq:triangulations 768-772, eq:triangulations_high_gen 844-847); downstream of the reused enumeration core.

results.title: Mesoscopic scaling limit
results.note: Both models, scale sqrt(s_n/n), local pointed Gromov--Hausdorff convergence to F_Plan and F_Unic; limits built from the dual UIPT and the 3-regular tree with exponential edge lengths and mass-biased bipointed CRTs. Not contained in 2107.

results.title: Contour convergence to Brownian motion with drift
results.note: Hypotheses sqrt(n) << c_n << n; time rescaling (kappa n/c_n)^2 and height c_n/(kappa n). Proof 1221-1228 from counter_index 16. Counted inside the mesoscopic candidate, not separately.

results.title: Local CLT for the bridge near both endpoints
results.note: Proof 1187-1217: conditioning an asymmetric random walk, explicit absolute-continuity density ratio, Stirling estimates. A genuine estimate but part of the mesoscopic core.

results.title: Size of the distinguished tree
results.note: Proof 1241-1257 uses the cycle-lemma count of first-passage paths and Stirling; presented as a direct alternative to the excursion argument. No separate candidate.

results.title: Tree regimes below the mesoscopic scale
results.note: 作者树尺度伴随结果：uniform root tree/rerooting/known uniform-plane-tree limits的短证明，以及同桥/轮廓无漂移替代；保留完整作者材料，独立计核0，不另标第二个H2。
results.producer_original_note: New limit statement (local convergence to the uniform infinite plane tree; a_n^{-1} scaling to the self-similar tree for a_n = o(sqrt(n/s_n))). Proof 1377-1379 plus prose 1381-1398 relies on the uniform law of the root tree, rerooting invariance, known local limits of uniform plane trees (Jan12; Ald91c) and the drift-free case of counter_index 16. Recorded as H2 material, not proposed as an independent advanced candidate; it does not inherit 2107 and does not extend the mesoscopic candidate core.

source_notation_points.literal: implicitly restrict ourselves to odd integers $\spar_n$

notes: All maps are finite, rooted, not necessarily bipartite. M_n(f,g): n edges, f faces, genus g. Sparsity s_n=f_n+2g_n. Standing assumption s_n -> infinity and s_n/n -> 0 (eq:standing, 167-169).
Planar model M_n(s_n,0); unicellular model M_n(1,(s_n-1)/2), s_n odd. lambda_circ = 1 - sqrt(3)/2 planar and 0 unicellular (eq:lambda, 232-236).
The defect-theorem proof eventually needs 3 s_n <= n/32 (line 957); this is proof-internal and compatible with the finite-crossover hypothesis s_n^3/n -> a, and must not be added to the statement.
Paragraph 335-337 about general (f_n,g_n) and PSHIT is conjecture-supporting prose, not a result.
No definition or example environment occurs; definitions (core, kernel, defect, T_defect, contraction, P^bullet, three-regular tree, self-similar tree) are prose.
